customer_id.description: Customer ID that will be associated with the Google Pay payment method.

cardDetails.description: Commonly the last four digits of the selected payment account number.

cardNetwork.description: The payment card network of the selected payment. values match the format of allowedCardNetworks in [CardParameters](https://developers.google.com/pay/api/web/reference/request-objects#CardParameters).

accountVerified.description: If true, indicates that Cardholder possession validation has been performed on returned payment credential.

cardHolderAuthenticated.description: Indicates whether identification and verifications (ID&V) was performed on the returned payment credential.

cardFundingSource.description: Card funding source for the selected payment method. Possible values: `UNKNOWN`, `CREDIT`, `DEBIT`, `PREPAID`

token.description: The generated payment method token. See [TokenizationSpecification](https://developers.google.com/pay/api/web/reference/request-objects#PaymentMethodTokenizationSpecification)

type.description: The type of tokenization to be applied to the selected payment method.

description.description: User-facing message to describe the payment method that funds this transaction.

type.description: PaymentMethod type selected in the Google Pay payment sheet. See [PaymentMethod](https://developers.google.com/pay/api/web/reference/request-objects#PaymentMethod)
